title: YOU ARE NOT A THING
semantic_visual_contract: Every frame must visibly prove the line, primary symbol, and requested transformation. Stock fallback is forbidden.

voice_standard.minimum: equal or better naturalness than approved reference

scenes.text: What if you are not a thing? I know. That is a rude way to start a conversation.
scenes.semantic_anchor: identity may be a continuing pattern rather than a fixed object
scenes.symbol_query: a human outline continuously rebuilt from moving particles while the word PATTERN remains stable; no stock footage
scenes.query: a human outline continuously rebuilt from moving particles while the word PATTERN remains stable; no stock footage

scenes.text: You woke up, paid bills, found your keys after accusing everybody in the house of moving them… and now somebody is telling you that you might not even be an object.
scenes.semantic_anchor: ordinary routines make identity feel object-like, then the object assumption is challenged
scenes.symbol_query: household bills and a key visibly return to the same person while OBJECT? is questioned; no unrelated people
scenes.query: household bills and a key visibly return to the same person while OBJECT? is questioned; no unrelated people

scenes.text: But look closer. A whirlpool is not made of specific water.
scenes.semantic_anchor: a whirlpool is a stable form made from changing water
scenes.symbol_query: overhead whirlpool whose particles change while the vortex geometry remains unmistakable
scenes.query: overhead whirlpool whose particles change while the vortex geometry remains unmistakable

scenes.text: The water keeps leaving. New water keeps entering. Yet somehow, the whirlpool remains.
scenes.semantic_anchor: material flows through while the form remains
scenes.symbol_query: arrows show water entering and leaving one persistent whirlpool form
scenes.query: arrows show water entering and leaving one persistent whirlpool form

scenes.text: So what exactly is the whirlpool? Not the water. The relationship between movement, pressure, gravity, and shape. It is a pattern wearing water for a little while.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the whirlpool is the relationship among forces, not the water itself
scenes.symbol_query: movement pressure gravity and shape visibly converge to sustain a whirlpool relationship
scenes.query: movement pressure gravity and shape visibly converge to sustain a whirlpool relationship

scenes.text: And maybe you are doing the same thing. Your body has changed. Your thoughts have changed. Your beliefs have changed.
scenes.semantic_anchor: body, thoughts, and beliefs change while a recognizable self-pattern continues
scenes.symbol_query: BODY THOUGHTS and BELIEFS layers slide and change around one continuing self outline
scenes.query: BODY THOUGHTS and BELIEFS layers slide and change around one continuing self outline

scenes.text: You have lost cells, gained memories, forgotten passwords, changed opinions, and probably become deeply offended by something you once agreed with.
scenes.semantic_anchor: cells, memories, passwords, and opinions are replaceable components
scenes.symbol_query: CELLS MEMORIES PASSWORDS and OPINIONS tiles change around a fixed ME label
scenes.query: CELLS MEMORIES PASSWORDS and OPINIONS tiles change around a fixed ME label

scenes.text: Yet you still call all of it “me.” But what stayed? Not the material. Not the mood. Not even the story. What stayed was the relationship between the pieces.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the self persists as the relationship between changing pieces
scenes.symbol_query: changing geometric pieces remain connected in one persistent relationship network
scenes.query: changing geometric pieces remain connected in one persistent relationship network

scenes.text: You may not be a solid person moving through time. You may be an arrangement that keeps rebuilding the idea of a person.
scenes.semantic_anchor: a person is continually reconstructed rather than carried unchanged
scenes.symbol_query: particles repeatedly disassemble and rebuild a person-shaped arrangement
scenes.query: particles repeatedly disassemble and rebuild a person-shaped arrangement

scenes.text: Like a song. A song is not the piano. It is not the speaker. It is not even the air vibrating in the room.
scenes.semantic_anchor: a song is independent of any one piano, speaker, or air vibration
scenes.symbol_query: piano speaker and air-wave icons surround one continuous song waveform
scenes.query: piano speaker and air-wave icons surround one continuous song waveform

scenes.text: Destroy the piano, and the song can still be played somewhere else. Because the song was never trapped inside the instrument. The instrument was just one place the relationship became audible.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the same song can continue through a different instrument and location
scenes.symbol_query: piano dissolves while the identical waveform continues in a new location
scenes.query: piano dissolves while the identical waveform continues in a new location

scenes.text: That raises an uncomfortable question. What if your body is not producing you? What if your body is where your pattern is currently being played?
scenes.semantic_anchor: the body may be the current receiver or instrument of the self-pattern
scenes.symbol_query: a body outline behaves as a receiver through which a larger pattern waveform plays
scenes.query: a body outline behaves as a receiver through which a larger pattern waveform plays

scenes.text: Now, before you start floating away from your taxes, calm down. This does not mean you are secretly a Wi-Fi signal from another dimension.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the metaphysical idea is grounded with taxes and a Wi-Fi joke
scenes.symbol_query: bills anchor the frame while a router signal joke is clearly secondary
scenes.query: bills anchor the frame while a router signal joke is clearly secondary

scenes.text: Though, honestly, some of us do lose connection every time we walk into the kitchen and forget why we went in there.
scenes.semantic_anchor: entering a room can interrupt the active mental pattern
scenes.symbol_query: floor plan shows a person entering the kitchen and the active thought marker disappearing
scenes.query: floor plan shows a person entering the kitchen and the active thought marker disappearing

scenes.text: But consider this. A family is not a collection of bodies. It is a pattern of memories, tensions, jokes, loyalties, expectations, and one person who refuses to admit they started the argument.
scenes.semantic_anchor: a family is a network of memories, tensions, jokes, loyalties, and expectations
scenes.symbol_query: family pattern shown as a network labeled memories tensions jokes loyalties expectations
scenes.query: family pattern shown as a network labeled memories tensions jokes loyalties expectations

scenes.text: A city is not its buildings. Replace every brick slowly enough, and people still call it the same city.
scenes.semantic_anchor: a city remains recognizable while its bricks are gradually replaced
scenes.symbol_query: city skyline remains while individual brick cells are visibly replaced
scenes.query: city skyline remains while individual brick cells are visibly replaced

scenes.text: A flame is not the wood. The wood disappears. The flame continues. Reality may preserve processes more faithfully than it preserves objects.
scenes.semantic_anchor: a flame is a continuing process while its wood is consumed
scenes.symbol_query: wood shrinks and disappears while the flame continues as a stable process
scenes.query: wood shrinks and disappears while the flame continues as a stable process

scenes.text: We keep staring at the costume while reality keeps protecting the dance.
scenes.semantic_anchor: reality preserves the dance rather than the costume
scenes.symbol_query: costume outline fades while a luminous dance path keeps moving
scenes.query: costume outline fades while a luminous dance path keeps moving

scenes.text: Maybe death, change, identity, and time seem so confusing because we are asking what happens to the thing… when the deeper question is what happens to the pattern.
scenes.semantic_anchor: questions about death, change, identity, and time confuse the thing with the pattern
scenes.symbol_query: solid cube marked THING transforms into a connected living PATTERN network
scenes.query: solid cube marked THING transforms into a connected living PATTERN network

scenes.text: You may have spent your whole life trying to protect the instrument… without realizing reality has always been listening to the music.
scenes.semantic_anchor: we protect the instrument while reality has always been listening to the music
scenes.symbol_query: instrument silhouettes fade beneath expanding waves while reality listens to the music
scenes.query: instrument silhouettes fade beneath expanding waves while reality listens to the music
